prompts.p: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D aquarium game swimming sprite animation. Input image is the exact character identity and rendering reference. Create a clean 1024x1024 transparent PNG sprite pose sheet, EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal 512x512 cells, reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. One complete character per cell, generous transparent margin. Same character, same eyes, same colors, same lighting, same scale, same torso position in every cell; fixed camera, no rotation. No text, numbers, grid lines, shadows on ground, bubbles, food or other objects. Background genuinely transparent, not painted checkerboard. Four sequential evenly spaced poses of ONE smooth seamless periodic swim cycle; frame4 transitions smoothly back to frame1. Each pose must visibly change appendage geometry, never merely translate or scale the entire original. Preserve the reference orange peach upright seahorse facing RIGHT, golden eye, spiny crest, cream belly and curled tail. The translucent mint dorsal fin ripples: phase0 swept aft, phase1 open outward, phase2 swept forward, phase3 folding toward aft. Keep head, trunk and tail virtually identical and upright. Delicate real fin shape changes, no overlapping duplicate fins. Use 4% height gentle bob maximum, ideally fixed head.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D aquarium game mermaid swimming animation. Reference image defines the EXACT approved moon-tide mermaid: aqua flowing hair, gold flower clip, blue eyes, modest white/mint bodice, blue violet scales, lavender fan-shaped tail fin. Preserve her character design, outfit, face and soft anime rendering exactly. Create a transparent landscape pose sheet, exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight equal cells, reading order left to right then bottom row. Canvas 1536x1024. ONE entire mermaid per cell with generous margins. Same camera, same head and torso location, same scale and same face in every cell. Head faces right, body in the original curved swimming pose. ONLY lower flexible tail and broad lavender fan-fin undulate: starts neutral curved, flexes upward gradually through phases2-3, passes neutral at5, flexes downward through6-7, approaches start at8. Keep anatomy consistent, one tail per character, no doubled translucent outlines.
